lessons: Checks were green. Review raised one fixable snag: kill on a paused drain. `_wait_for_offer` loops on `allow_offer()`, which stays False while a pause hold is set, so the drain never sees `stopping`. It reports applied but keeps running and keeps the lock.

Fix: make the offer wait end once the stop latch is set. Either `_wait_for_offer` returns when `_stopping` is true and the caller checks `_stopping` before treating the result as a ceiling halt, or `allow_offer` returns True once `stopping` is set so the post-wait check returns `_killed()`.

Add a kill-while-paused case to tests/test_kill_cli_activation.py. Pause the live drain, then run kill. Assert `stopped: kill accepted`, lock release (prove it by reacquiring the lock), and no later dispatch or retry draw.

Keep what worked. Concurrent kill during dispatch reaches Stages.abort_active. Control-consumer failure cancels and awaits the dispatch. Stale kill mutates nothing. No-engine kill refuses before any journal or lifecycle is created. Pause keeps next-boundary ordering.

Keep the diff compact and scoped. Do not delete unrelated docstrings, why-comments, typing, or the __main__ docstring. The byte counts in the seed fixture are historical; only the render headroom bound applies.
reason: Checks were green and the one review snag, kill during a pause hold, is a narrow fix with a concrete paved road; the same capability can do it.
